author: DistroTube
description:
Origami is a next-generation Linux distribution built on Fedora Atomic. It uses the Cosmic Desktop that was developed by PopOS. It also uses the CachyOS kernel. Oh...and it replaces a lot of the standard shell utilities with modern Rust alternatives!
